author: Forbes
description:
If you're a recent graduate and feel like you're falling behind, this episode is for you.
The reality is that today's job market looks very different than it did just a few years ago. Recent graduates are facing the highest unemployment rate in over a decade, while more than 41% of young degree holders are underemployed. At the same time, companies are increasingly prioritizing experienced candidates over entry-level talent.
So what can you actually do about it?
In this episode of Work Hotline, Sho Dewan breaks down the new playbook for graduates entering the workforce in 2026:
• Why proof of work matters more than resumes
• Why applying to hundreds of jobs isn't always the answer
• How to stand out when everyone is using AI
• Why your first job doesn't need to be your dream job
• What recruiters are actually looking for right now
Plus, Sho answers real calls from graduates struggling with comparison, imposter syndrome, underemployment, and the pressure of figuring out adulthood.

title: Why Gen Z Can't Find Jobs (And What To Do About It)

author: Forbes
description:
From Vietnam to Billionaire: Bob Parsons’ Extraordinary Journey
In this candid conversation with Forbes Executive Editor Luisa Kroll, Bob Parsons—founder of GoDaddy and PXG—reflects on the experiences that shaped his remarkable journey from a troubled childhood and Marine Corps service during the Vietnam War to becoming a billionaire entrepreneur and philanthropist.

Parsons shares how overcoming adversity, coping with PTSD, and embracing relentless hard work helped fuel his success in business. He discusses entrepreneurship, risk-taking, leadership, and the lessons he learned along the way, while also reflecting on family, personal growth, and the advice he would give his younger self.
